payload.name: LLM + Docs Signal Exhaustive Scraper

external_source_policy.scope: only sources relevant to extracted entities, projects, businesses, URLs, people, tools, products, risks, opportunities, and repeated intent signals

scrape_strategy.pass_1: inventory all files/folders, hash content, classify source type, detect sensitive columns, do not mutate originals
scrape_strategy.pass_2: extract entities, URLs, businesses, project names, tools, people, topics, decisions, repeated wants, risks, obligations, and capabilities
scrape_strategy.pass_3: cluster into signal graph: identity, intent, capability, product, infra, ops, commercial, memory, trust, security, compliance, relationships
scrape_strategy.pass_4: generate permutations: entity x source x time x business x capability x action; enqueue only high-value candidates
scrape_strategy.pass_5: compare against current T4H docs/global rules/WIP/PEN/audit logs to find drift, missing docs, stale claims, and orphaned ideas
scrape_strategy.pass_6: write receipts, source index, graph deltas, candidate jobs, and rejected/low-confidence ideas with reasons

definition_of_done: all readable files hashed and classified
sensitive files flagged before extraction summaries
permutation jobs generated with confidence score and value score
external research queue created from extracted entities only
no source file deleted or modified
